svg.title: GLP-1 NAION reports to the FDA jumped after the first study, and more now come from consumers and lawyers
svg.desc: FDA adverse event reports coding optic ischemic neuropathy that name a GLP-1 drug, by year received and who reported them. 2012 to 2023: 14 (7 health professionals, 7 consumers). 2024: 65 (48 health professionals, 17 consumers). 2025: 426 (217 health professionals, 197 consumers, 11 lawyers). January to June 2026: 330 (104 health professionals, 201 consumers, 24 lawyers). Physicians filed 62% of 2024 reports and 21% in 2026.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Reports surged after the news, and shifted away from doctors
